PLAN "12-Week Conditioning Plan for Endometriosis-Friendly Program with Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition, Aerobic Base Building, Metabolic Conditioning, Plyometrics, Phase 3 Testing & Endometriosis-Sensitive Progression" 
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Endometriosis-aware, low-impact strength & mobility progression"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & low-impact strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes steady_state
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          thoracic_extension 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility & core stability":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..15 each side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 10 minutes easy
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          cat_cow 60 seconds
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-body, low-impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rower 10 minutes moderate
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive load & technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          glute_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes steady_state
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Mobility & core":
        warmup:
          marching 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pallof_press 3x12..16 each side rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mats 60 seconds
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Conditioned strength, lower impact":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 60 seconds
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 8 minutes moderate
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Load management & stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes easy
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility & core maintenance":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

        cardio:

        main straight_sets:

          incline_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 6 minutes easy
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & technique focus":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 5x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds

          cycling 12 minutes moderate

          walking 12 minutes easy

        DAY Friday training 50m "Maintenance & consistency":

            tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cardio:
            rowing 8 minutes moderate
          cooldown:
            chest_stretch 60 seconds
            tricep_stretch 60 seconds

  HIIT_PHASE "Phase 2 Metabolic Conditioning Day" (4 weeks):

      DAY Saturday training 30m "Metabolic Conditioning (Low-impact HIIT)">

            goblet_squat 2x12 rest 30 seconds
            lat_pulldown 2x12 rest 30 seconds

            bicycle_crunch 2x20 reps
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds

    - This plan includes Phase 3 with testing and a Phase 2 metabolic conditioning day, plus a Phase 4 extension if needed for progression.

    - All exercises use canonical vocabulary; adjust loads by clinician guidance as symptoms dictate.

  NUTRITION_GOALS
    - Anti-inflammatory eating pattern to support symptom management and recovery
    - Adequate protein and fiber per day
    - Emphasis on whole foods, colorful produce, healthy fats
    - Hydration: 30-35 ml per kg body weight daily (adjust for intake)
  NUTRITION_RULES
    - Prioritize: vegetables, fruits, legumes, whole grains, fatty fish, olive oil, nuts, seeds
    - Limit: processed foods, added sugars, refined fats, high-sodium items
    - Avoid: excessive caffeine near bedtime if sensitive
  DAILY_MACROS (example targets; adjust with clinician)
    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight
    - Fat: 25–35% of total calories
    - Carbohydrates: remainder of calories
  ANTI_INFLAMMATORY_FOODS
    - Fatty fish (salmon, sardines), flaxseed, chia seeds
    - Extra-virgin olive oil, avocados, nuts
    - Berries, leafy greens, cruciferous vegetables
    - Turmeric (with black pepper), ginger
    - Whole grains (oats, quinoa, brown rice)
  FOODS_TO_LIMIT
    - Processed meats, refined grains, deep-fried items
    - Highly processed snack foods
  MEAL_PLAN_STRUCTURE
    - Breakfast ideas: overnight oats with berries and chia, or Greek yogurt with nuts and fruit
    - Lunch ideas: salmon salad with mixed greens, quinoa; lentil soup with vegetables
    - Dinner ideas: turkey/chicken or tofu bowl with vegetables and brown rice or quinoa; roasted vegetables with olive oil
    - Snack ideas: fruit with nuts, hummus with vegetables, yogurt with seeds
  HYDRATION
    - Water: aim for consistent intake across day; herbal teas allowed
  SUPPLEMENT_ADVICE
    - Consider vitamin D3 if deficient, omega-3 fatty acids from fish or algal oil; discuss with clinician
  CYCLE_ADAPTATIONS
    - On flare days or heavy pain days, simplify meals to balanced, easily digestible options; avoid heavy meals late in the day
  WEEKLY_PLANNING
    - Prepare a 4-day rotating grocery list; batch-cook proteins, grains, and vegetables
    - Include anti-inflammatory spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic) in meals
  TRACKING
    - Food diary or app to monitor inflammation signs, energy, and GI symptoms
  NOTES
    - This full plan integrates strength, aerobic base, metabolic conditioning, plyometrics, and Phase 3 testing considerations with anti-inflammatory nutrition and endometriosis-aware adjustments. Clinician clearance for 1RM testing is assumed; adjust as advised.

NUTRITION PLAN
  NUTRITION_GOALS
    - Anti-inflammatory eating pattern to support symptom management and recovery

  NUTRITION_RULES
    - Prioritize: vegetables, fruits, legumes, whole grains, fatty fish, olive oil, nuts, seeds
    - Limit: processed foods, added sugars, refined fats, high-sodium items

  DAILY_MACROS (example targets; adjust with clinician)

    - Fat: 25–35% of total calories
    - Carbohydrates: remainder of calories

    - Extra-virgin olive oil, avocados, nuts
    - Berries, leafy greens, cruciferous vegetables
    - Turmeric (with black pepper), ginger
    - Whole grains (oats, quinoa, brown rice)
  FOODS_TO_LIMIT
    - Processed meats, refined grains, deep-fried items
    - Highly processed snack foods

    - Water: aim for consistent intake across day; herbal teas allowed

    - Consider vitamin D3 if deficient, omega-3 fatty acids from fish or algal oil; discuss with clinician
  CYCLE_ADAPTATIONS
    - On flare days or heavy pain days, simplify meals to balanced, easily digestible options; avoid heavy meals late in the day

    - Prepare a 4-day rotating grocery list; batch-cook proteins, grains, and vegetables
    - Include anti-inflammatory spices (turmeric, ginger, garlic) in meals
  TRACKING
    - Food diary or app to monitor inflammation signs, energy, and GI symptoms
